name: agy
description: Drive agy (Google Antigravity CLI) from Codex like a subagent, on this machine or over SSH on others: live progress, mid-turn messages, approvals, stall watchdog, auto-recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Run and supervise agy (Antigravity CLI) sessions here or on other machines
interface.longDescription: Hand tasks to agy and supervise it like a subagent: stream its progress, steer it mid-turn, answer its approvals, cancel or resume. A background broker keeps agy from hanging (watchdog, kill and reload, auto-recovery) and enforces read-only sessions by default. Works locally and over SSH on Linux, macOS and Windows hosts.
defaultPrompt: 让 agy 看一下这个仓库的测试为什么失败
